metadata.name: Ermentrout-Kopell Map Neuron
metadata.author: Ermentrout, G.B. & Kopell, N.
metadata.description: Forward-Euler implementation of the canonical Type-I theta equation on a circular phase domain

threshold.condition: theta_prev < theta_threshold <= (theta_prev + 0.1 * ((1.0 - cos(theta_prev)) + (1.0 + cos(theta_prev)) * gain * I))

extensions.source_equation_note: The continuous theta equation follows Ermentrout and Kopell (1986), DOI 10.1137/0146017.
extensions.discretisation_note: dt=0.1, gain, explicit Euler, modulo 2*pi, and the pi event convention are maintained implementation choices; they are not presented as a discrete recurrence from the 1986 paper.
extensions.silicon_cosim_note: Hand/TOML/JSON float64 states and events are exact. Over 2000 steps Q16.16 preserves the class-correct spike counts at I=-0.5 (0) and I=1.0 (64); maximum circular phase errors are below 0.081 and 0.025 rad respectively. Event timing and full trajectories are not claimed exact because the cosine LUT is quantised.
